title: Automated speed enforcement expansion and GRT route #2 closure
subtitle: Also: provincial planning statement report sent back to staff, New Dundee water treatment upgrades, and #73 route impacts.
overview: The Planning and Works Committee recommended speeding up the 2023 Automated Speed Enforcement expansion to reach 32 sites {{vote:m4}}. This involves advancing $362,000 in capital funding and starting a new Traffic Engineering Technologist as early as June 1, 2023. Staff said vendors can mobilize quickly, and that revenue is expected to exceed expenditures once the program is running. The 2023 expansion focuses on school zones.

On transit, the committee recommended that staff continue public information sessions, explore ways to lessen the impact of closing GRT routes #2 and #73, and report back to Council in June 2023. The motion was amended to add route #73. Route #2 serves several neighbourhoods and vulnerable riders.

The committee referred the report on the proposed new Provincial Planning Statement back to staff after concerns about how it described area municipalities. It is due at Council on May 24, 2023, and the province's comment period ends June 5, 2023. On the consent agenda, the committee also recommended accepting the New Dundee water supply iron and manganese treatment upgrades environmental assessment and starting real estate acquisitions.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended advancing $362,000 in capital funding and an earlier start for a new Traffic Engineering Technologist to reach 32 sites in 2023 {{vote:m4}}.
The committee recommended that staff continue public information sessions, explore alternatives to mitigate the closure of routes #2 and #73, and report back to Council in June 2023.
The committee amended the notice of motion so that its direction to explore alternatives also covers route #73.
The committee referred the report back to staff for changes discussed at the meeting, to return to Council on May 24, 2023.

The committee recommended accepting the Class Environmental Assessment Project File Report, publishing the Notice of Completion for public review, and authorizing staff to begin required real estate acquisitions.
